title: Credentials in scripts
description:
Security rule — script steps that reference credential-related keywords (password, secret, apikey, token, …) across all files. Actual values are masked with ***** so the dashboard never leaks plaintext secrets.

Replaces the earlier DDR-calculation heuristic (hardcoded_credential): this bundle scans every script step, masks the values and adds keyword chips plus a multi-file view.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A credential referenced literally in a script step ends up in the DDR, in backups and in every copy of the file.
rule.remediation: Move the secret into a protected settings field, a server-side parameter, or an external secret store.
